question: Aliases bN-Maize-... (N = 1-3) are taken as the three independent biological replicates (planted and harvested on separate dates). Batch b2 was sequenced with 76 nt reads and about 17-29 M reads per library; b1 (51 nt, about 9-10 M reads) and b3 (51 nt, about 18-25 M reads) differ. Is b = replicate (and batch) as assumed?
proposed_answer: Yes, replicate = N in bN. Batch (b1, b2, b3) is confounded with replicate and, for b2, with read length/depth; contrasts should block on batch (replicate pairs are cold and control from the same batch).
evidence: Paper: 'three independent biological replicates ... planted and harvested on separate dates'; runs.tsv read_length and n_spots; BioSample aliases.

item: Tissue: whole plant or aboveground tissue
question: BioSample says tissue 'whole plant'; Methods say each sample is a pool of all aboveground tissue (leaf blades, ligules, leaf sheaths; no apical meristems, stems or roots) of 3-5 seedlings.
proposed_answer: tissue_group = Shoot (paper wins), tissue_detail records both; not 'Whole seedling'.
evidence: Methods of doi 10.1105/tpc.17.00354 (cold stress time course), BioSample attribute tissue.

question: Catalogue rows give genotype, temperatures and age as NR, and PMC full text via the PubMed tool is empty. Values read from the PMC web page: maize B73 (BioSample cultivar B73), 10 d after planting (BioSample dev_stage 10day; Methods: sorghum 12 d equals maize 10 d, planting dates staggered), control 29 °C day/23 °C night, cold 6 °C day and night, 12 h/12 h light cycle, cold onset immediately before the end of daylight.
proposed_answer: Recorded as read. The age of 10 d comes from the greenhouse experiment text and the BioSample; the Methods do not repeat it for the time course ('planted as above').

question: Samples were harvested from both control and cold treatments at 0.5, 1, 3, 6, 16 and 24 h after cold onset. Onset was at lights-off, so 0.5-6 h fall in the dark, 16 h is 4 h into the next light period and 24 h at the end of day. Alias suffix '05h' (and '05' in b2-Maize-cold-05) = 0.5 h.
proposed_answer: time_h = 0.5, 1, 3, 6, 16, 24 for both cold and control samples (time-matched); '05' read as 0.5 h. No time-zero samples.

item: Second BioProject PRJNA343268 not in runs.tsv
question: The paper cites two accessions: PRJNA344653 (this time course, 36 maize runs) and PRJNA343268 ('Cold stress and control on panicoid grass species', 30 runs over five species, maize aliases Maize-b1..b3-control and Maize-b1..b3-1d, i.e. 6 maize runs: the greenhouse experiment with 1 d cold vs control). It is listed as an uncatalogued maize cold record, not assigned to a study.
proposed_answer: Consider adding PRJNA343268 to Zhang2017 (greenhouse cold experiment, maize 3 replicates x control/1 d cold; harvested 3 h before lights on) in M1/M2; not curated here because its runs are not in runs.tsv.
evidence: ENA filereport for PRJNA343268 (checked 20 Oct 2026); uncatalogued_repository_records.tsv; Methods 'Accession Numbers'.

question: PRJNA344653 is also listed under Zeng2021 as role exclude (cited for comparison only).
proposed_answer: Zhang2017 owns the 36 maize runs; nothing to curate under Zeng2021.

question: The 6 maize runs (3 control, 3 cold 24 h at 6 °C) were added to runs.tsv and this sheet. Controls stayed in the greenhouse (29/23 °C, 13 h day) while cold plants were moved to a 6 °C growth chamber (12 h day, much lower light), so the contrast mixes cold with the move and the light change.
